description: Easily download and manage single-player game cheats for your convenience. An open-source dashboard that brings trainers from Fling, XiaoXing, Cheat Engine tables and community uploads into one place, with instant English/Chinese search.
notes: Settings are stored in '%APPDATA%\GCM Settings' and downloaded trainers default to '%APPDATA%\GCM Trainers'.
Trainers modify game memory and may trigger false-positive antivirus alerts. Use the in-app Windows Defender helper to whitelist your trainer folders.
Disable 'Check app updates' in Settings to keep the built-in updater (Updater.exe) from conflicting with Scoop.
